subject: The 2-minute thesis hack 90% of users skip
preview_text: I wasn't going to share this, but it turns 20 minutes of panic into 2 minutes of flow. Don't make this mistake.
body_paragraphs: Remember that feeling? The clock ticking, the blank page staring back, and you know you need a thesis statement NOW. You'd spend 20 minutes just trying to phrase one decent sentence. I used to do that too. Every single time.

Then I discovered something stupidly simple. It's not about writing the perfect thesis first. It's about generating three terrible ones in 60 seconds. Your brain works better when it has options to reject. The pressure to be perfect vanishes. You go from paralyzed to productive instantly.

That's why I built the 'Rapid Draft' mode into Thesis Generator. You put in your topic, hit the button, and get three wildly different thesis statements in under a minute. One will be close. You tweak it. Suddenly, you're not starting from zero—you're editing, which is 10x easier. What used to be a 20-minute mental block is now a 2-minute warm-up.

Open the app right now. Don't open it later when you're panicking. Open it now, when you're calm, and just try 'Rapid Draft' with any old topic. See how fast it works. Get familiar with beating the blank page on your terms. P.S. The students who do this one thing before a deadline have the calmest, most productive writing sessions. They're not smarter. They're just using the 2-minute hack.
